_comment: Every lesson line on monogate.dev that says a theorem is proved, or is not, with what re-derives it. scripts/check_lesson_proofs.mjs runs before each deploy: for each verdict it runs the page's own `eml-compile <source> --target lean` command, on the page's own source with `edits` applied, using the monogate-forge a reader installs; appends `#print axioms <theorem>`; runs `lake env lean` in ../machlib/foundations; and requires no sorryAx for "proved", sorryAx for "not_proved", and, when `quoted`, the report the page quotes. Every `lines` entry must still be on the page, and a "monogate-forge X.Y.Z" inside one must be the version the run used. `generic` lists lines that say "not proved" or "shows sorryAx" without stating a verdict about a theorem. To add a verdict to a lesson, register it here in the same change; if its line carries an "is proved" label, exempt it in scripts/lean_claims.json citing check_lesson_proofs.
